# Gemini / Google AI China Guide by ChongGrok

> Independent Gemini membership and troubleshooting knowledge base. It separates own-account upgrades from the Gemini-only one-year ready-made account option. ChongGrok is not affiliated with Google.

## Scope

- Own-account membership upgrade requirements are confirmed case by case; no fixed credential is claimed.
- Passwords, two-factor codes and recovery codes are not requested for own-account upgrades.
- A one-year Google AI Pro ready-made account is a separate Gemini-only delivery path governed by the live product page and pre-purchase terms.
- No API credits, SMS verification or bulk registration.
- Plans, prices, features and availability follow Google's live official pages.
